verdict.summary: The change consistently prevents silent partial-population processing: bounded `gh pr list` consumers now fail closed on saturation, while issue-deduplication consumers use exhaustive REST pagination and exclude pull requests returned by the issues endpoint. The tests exercise the production call sites, include below-cap/absent-marker negative controls, model both capped and paginated CLI result shapes, and verify that PR bodies cannot create false deduplication. I found no correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect in the supplied diff.
